profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Mint Mobile

positions.title: Senior Accountant
positions.description:
- Launched meetings with practice leads to review high-cost contractors and financial trends to drive continued business growth
- Implemented an innovative invoice automation system generating 200+ invoices per month, reducing invoicing time by 2 days

positions.title: Staff Accountant
positions.description:
- Assisted in all stages of month-end close, including project reconciliation, invoicing, final review, and reporting
- Streamlined the 1099 process, transitioning from the work of three days to one day

projects.title: Nordstrom Back-End Optimization
projects.description:
-Inherited Nordstrom front-end mock-up and optimized back-end code to handle 3500 RPS with a latency of 31 ms and 0.1% error rate. 
-Benchmarked query time between SQL vs Non-SQL database management systems. 
-Deployed to Amazon EC2 instances and used a load balancer to handle large volumes of traffic.

projects.title: Petfinder Front-End Mock Up
projects.description:
-Created a mock-up of Petfinder's product detail page, mimicking the exact user experience of the actual webpage. 
-Designed and implemented the photo carousel component, which included infinite scrolling, a popup modal to the display large versions of photos, and a dynamic photo navigation toolbar. 
-Utilized a proxy server to combine 3 different microservices.
